jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABOON

Setting up a 401(k) shouldn't be the hardest thing a business ever does. But retirement plan administration is complex, fragmented, and manual — and it slows down both business owners and the advisors who serve them. Aboon was founded to change that.

We're an AI-native third-party administrator (TPA) that makes it easy for advisors to offer 401(k)s and other retirement products by pairing streamlined workflows with dedicated human service. Backed by leading investors including Bain Capital and Edward Jones Ventures, we bring decades of experience building for advisors and the retirement industry. We're looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to build it with us.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As we expand our partner base and bring new products to market, the Aboon brand needs to shine: preceding us in conversations with broker-dealers, wirehouses, and RIAs, establishing us as a thought leader in the retirement advisor space, and supporting our distribution as we scale.

This is our first dedicated marketing hire. You'll own the function: strategy and execution, the demand engine that powers GTM, brand building and thought leadership, and sales enablement. You'll report to our CEO and work closely with GTM, product, and leadership.

We're a lean, fully remote team that runs on autonomy and trust. You'll set the direction for how Aboon shows up in the market and execute against it — from the growth strategy down to writing the weekly email. This is a founding, hands-on seat: you won't have a team beneath you to start, and the role is built for someone who's energized by full ownership and building something from scratch.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Marketing strategy & growth

 - Own Aboon's marketing strategy and the plan to grow pipeline — translating business and distribution goals into an integrated marketing engine

 - Set the priorities, budget, and roadmap for how marketing creates and accelerates demand, and own marketing's contribution to pipeline and revenue alongside GTM

Demand generation & GTM

 - Build the engine that powers distribution: targeted, account-based programs and campaigns against our priority firms and advisor segments, working in lockstep with sales

 - Equip distribution to win — positioning, decks, one-pagers, objection-handling guides, and a library of assets that supports a scalable, repeatable motion

 - Develop co-marketing and partner programs with our broker-dealer, wirehouse, and platform partners to open and accelerate pipeline

 - Lead go-to-market for new product and partner launches, end to end

Lifecycle & email marketing

 - Own and evolve our email and lifecycle programs; build onboarding and nurture sequences as distribution expands to new partners and channels

Measurement & marketing operations

 - Own the martech stack and marketing data; track and report marketing's impact on pipeline and revenue (lead volume, conversion rates, influenced pipeline)

 - Partner with sales to measure what's working and continuously iterate to improve performance

Positioning & product marketing

 - Own our category narrative and value proposition, and the positioning and messaging for target segments: wirehouses, independent aggregators, RIAs, and insurance platforms

 - Monitor the competitive landscape and feed insights into messaging and strategy on an ongoing basis

Brand & thought leadership

 - Own Aboon's brand presence and the thought leadership strategy that creates demand and establishes us in the retirement advisor space — LinkedIn, industry media, and relevant awards and recognition

 - Develop case studies from live partner relationships that build advisory firm pipeline and trust

Events & conferences

 - Own our conference calendar, budget, presence strategy, and follow-up playbooks — one of our primary demand channels

 - Plan and execute booth presence, speaking opportunities, and post-event engagement across the retirement and financial services circuit




WHO YOU ARE

 - A retirement / financial services marketer: You've marketed to financial advisors, RIAs, or broker-dealer audiences in retirement, or in a close regulated proxy — insurance, fintech, wealth/asset management, or banking. You understand that home office and individual advisors are different audiences with different needs.

 - A natural builder-operator: You've built a marketing function from scratch or on a lean team, whether at an early-stage company or by standing up marketing inside a larger firm that didn't have it. You want top-to-bottom ownership of a function, and you're as excited by writing weekly email copy as elevating our brand voice.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and innovation: You're comfortable running multiple workstreams without a fully built playbook, setting your own priorities, and building systems as you go. You move fast, use AI to do more with less, and communicate clearly across a cross-functional team.

 - A team player with opinions: You'll work closely with strong voices across the leadership team. You share your views directly, push back when you think something's wrong, and know how to get to the right answer together.




WHAT YOU BRING

Required

 - Typically 15+ years of marketing experience, with meaningful retirement, or close financial-services proxy (insurance, fintech, wealth/asset management, banking), exposure

 - At least one stint building a marketing function from scratch or on a lean team; a purely large-firm background likely isn't a fit

 - Fluency marketing to sophisticated B2B audiences — advisors, RIAs, broker-dealers, plan sponsors, or institutional — within a regulated, compliance-heavy environment

 - Comfortable with marketing tools and platforms (Customer.io http://Customer.io, HubSpot, or equivalents), and using AI to operate lean

Preferred

 - Direct retirement, recordkeeping, or TPA experience




WHAT WE OFFER

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $180,000–$220,000, depending on experience, skills, and location. Total compensation also includes an annual bonus and equity.

Benefits

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, with additional optional coverage

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Flexible paid time off and holidays

 - 10 weeks paid parental leave

 - A fully remote work environment, with all the technology and equipment you need

 - Support for professional development and career growth

Location

Remote, though we encourage in-person attendance at 1-2 company retreats per year. There may also be occasional travel, including industry conferences (e.g., ASPPA Annual Conference and NAPA 401(k) Summit) and other relevant events.

This role is open to candidates based in the US. Work authorization required; no visa sponsorship.



Aboon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

jobs.title: Talent & People Director
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABOON

Setting up a 401(k) shouldn't be the hardest thing a business ever does. But retirement plan administration is complex, fragmented, and manual — and it slows down both business owners and the financial advisors who serve them. Aboon was founded to change that.

We're an AI-native third-party administrator (TPA) that makes it easy for financial advisors to offer 401(k)s and other retirement products by pairing streamlined workflows with dedicated human service. Backed by leading investors including Bain Capital and Edward Jones Ventures, we bring decades of experience building for advisors, business owners, and the retirement industry. We're looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to build it with us.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Aboon is scaling and hiring fast. As our Talent & People Director, you'll be the first dedicated hire on our People team, with an immediate mandate for recruiting: owning full-cycle hiring across the company and building the muscle that lets us grow well.

This role is recruiting-first by design. Your priority will be sourcing, screening, coordinating, and closing great people across every function. As the hiring pace normalizes, the role broadens into the work that makes Aboon a place people want to stay: onboarding, performance and review cycles, culture and events, learning and development, and the day-to-day operations of a growing team.

You'll report to our General Counsel, who leads People and Legal, and you'll partner closely with hiring managers and team leads across the company. You’ll have the chance to help build out the people function, with room to grow into a broader people leadership role as the company scales.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Recruiting

 - Own full-cycle recruiting across the company, from intake through offer, starting with over a dozen open roles spanning every function, and more ahead.

 - Partner with hiring managers to scope roles, define what "great" looks like, and run structured, fair interview processes.

 - Source proactively and build pipelines for the roles we hire repeatedly.

 - Run a clean, fast process in our ATS, Ashby: keep candidates moving, communicate promptly, and never let someone go dark.

 - Own candidate experience end to end so that every applicant comes away with a good impression of Aboon, offer or not.

 - Coordinate interviews, debriefs, and scheduling, and keep hiring managers on pace.

 - Manage relationships with any external search partners, and know when we need them versus when we don't.

 - Keep our job descriptions, interview kits, and offer process sharp, and report on pipeline health so we can course-correct early.

People Operations (growing over time)

 - Build a smooth onboarding experience so new hires ramp quickly and feel part of the team from day one.

 - Support our performance and review cycles, from setting up logistics and coordination to helping managers run them well.

 - Help shape culture, including team rituals, recognition, and our annual company retreats.

 - Support learning, training, and professional development programs as they grow.

 - Keep our people systems and records accurate and organized, and help make sense of people data.

 - Partner with the General Counsel on higher-level people strategy including compensation, org design, and policy.

 - Spot friction in how we work and propose better processes, including automation of repeatable work.




WHO YOU ARE

The right person is:

 - A closer at heart — you love the chase, move fast, and get great people to yes. High-volume hiring energizes you rather than wears you down.

 - Multi-faceted — you're strong at recruiting today and you actually want to grow into the broader people work.

 - A relationship builder — candidates, hiring managers, and teammates trust you, and you represent Aboon well to people meeting us for the first time.

 - Detail-oriented across systems — pipelines, schedules, and follow-ups are carefully orchestrated, and nothing falls through the cracks.

 - Self-directed — you know what your week produced without being asked, and you don't wait to be told what needs doing.




WHAT YOU BRING

Required

 - 7-10 years in recruiting, with substantial full-cycle, in-house experience owning roles from intake to close.

 - A track record hiring across functions at pace, ideally at a startup or high-growth company.

 - Fluency with an ATS and modern recruiting tools.

 - Strong written and verbal communication.

 - Sound judgment and discretion in dealing with people.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and building structure where little exists.

 - Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot in day-to-day work.

Nice to have

 - Genuine interest in growing into a broader People generalist or leadership path over time.

 - Exposure to people operations beyond recruiting, including onboarding, performance, culture, or L&D.

 - Experience with Ashby specifically.

 - A background in financial services, wealth, or fintech.

 - Experience at a small, growing firm or startup: you understand the "wear many hats" mentality.




WHAT WE OFFER

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $180,000-$200,000 depending on experience, skills, and location. Total compensation also includes an annual bonus and equity.

Benefits

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, with additional optional coverage

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Flexible paid time off and holidays

 - 10 weeks paid parental leave

 - A fully remote work environment, with all the technology and equipment you need

 - Support for professional development and career growth

Location

Remote, though we encourage in-person attendance at 1-2 company retreats per year. This role is open to candidates based in the US. Work authorization required; no visa sponsorship.



Aboon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.
